parsing_traps: STAPLED trust: 3-column statements (ACRO-REIT Group / ACRO-BT Group / Stapled Group). Stapled Group is canonical throughout. ACRO-REIT 'Rental revenue' US$38,464k is internal master-lease rent (eliminated on consolidation) -> NOT the trust's gross revenue. Gross revenue = Stapled Group US$158,625k (room + other operating revenue).
Currency is USD throughout (US trust, formerly ARA US Hospitality Trust). FY-end 31 December 2025.

COST-MODEL hotels: hotels are held as PPE (ACRO-BT, revalued via OCI with real P&L depreciation) and as investment properties (ACRO-REIT, fair-valued). The Statement of Comprehensive Income carries real D&A US$31,530k (unusual for SG REITs) -> included in operating_expense; ebitda = ebit + D&A.
income_taxes is a CREDIT US$167k (negative tax expense). Stored as -167,000 in income_stmt_metrics.income_taxes and as +167,000 SIGNED adjustment in line_items (so Sigma adjustment ties).
Taxation line in the P&L is shown as a positive +167 (credit added back); pretax loss (27,226) -> net loss after tax (27,059).

reconciliation.line_items_check: Sum(revenue) 158,625 - Sum(expense) 155,798 + Sum(adjustment signed) -29,886 = -27,059 (000s) = net_income. TIES.
reconciliation.gross_revenue_gap_note: Portfolio-List per-hotel revenue sums to US$156.8m vs Stapled-Group US$158.6m. Gap ~US$1.8m = partial-year revenue of the in-year-divested Hyatt Place Detroit Auburn Hills (sold Sep 2025, absent from the 32-hotel list) plus marketing-table rounding.
